channel.title: Daybrief
channel.description: AI first. Everything else that matters, twice a day.

item.title: affaan-m/ECC: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first…
item.description: ECC is an open-source performance optimization system for AI agent harnesses, offering skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, and Cursor. It has 289,194 GitHub stars. Why it matters: Covers tooling for coding agents across several platforms, with a large and fast-growing following on GitHub.

item.title: Panniantong/Agent-Reach: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili…
item.description: Agent-Reach is a single CLI that gives AI agents read and search access to platforms like Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, and XiaoHongShu, with no API fees. It has 102,832 GitHub stars. Why it matters: Touches AI models and AI agents.

item.title: NVIDIA/SkillSpector: Security scanner for AI agent skills. Detect vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, security risks, prompt…
item.description: NVIDIA's SkillSpector is a security scanner for AI agent skills, checking for vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, prompt injection and data exfiltration before install.

item.title: KillaBoi/StealMyBitcoin-PoC: A public release of the Steal My Bitcoin challenge
item.description: A single-file Python proof of concept reproducing the request sequence of a Steal My Bitcoin CTF solve, run against a local Docker lab.

item.title: heydeer/pngdeer: Lossy PNG compression that picks the quality for each image. Command line and browser, same bytes
item.description: Lossy PNG compression that picks the quality for each image. The command line and the browser run the same Rust code and write the same bytes.

item.title: Hiding Virtualization From Other Software
item.description: vfio-native, a tool that obscures virtualization using kernel patches, scored 1/85 on a VM detection test versus 10/85 for standard KVM.

item.title: 5 new power plants & Saudi oil storage at Jurong Rock Caverns: Tan See Leng outlines plans to enhance S'pore's energy security
item.description: Minister Tan See Leng outlined five new power plants and Saudi oil storage at Jurong Rock Caverns to enhance energy security.

item.title: Susquehanna raises Visa stock price target on AI agent opportunity
Why is Range Resources stock surging today?
At a glance: stocks gapping up premarket
BTC price risks $80K loss into FOMC, earnings: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
item.description: Bitcoin fights to hold $80,000 support, on track to end October down 4%, before a Fed decision expected to keep rates steady.

item.title: Arla protein pudding recalled due to potential presence of glass fragments
item.description: Singapore's Food Agency has recalled Arla Protein Salted Caramel Flavour Pudding (200g) over potential glass fragments, sold at FairPrice, Cold Storage and online retailers.

item.title: A shock in Brazil sends stocks plunging, while neoclouds take another hit
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva won a fourth term as Brazil's president, sparking a sell-off in Brazilian assets; rival Flávio Bolsonaro refuses to concede.

item.title: AI takes the easy decisions; leaders must get comfortable with the hard ones
item.description: As AI agents take over routine decisions, the author argues leaders' remaining decisions get harder and their mistakes become more visible.

item.title: Indonesia's gas cuts to Singapore put spotlight on domestic energy needs, economic trade-offs
item.description: Indonesia reduced natural gas exports to Singapore, diverting 31 million standard cubic feet a day to domestic electricity needs; analysts expect limited immediate impact.

item.title: Calpers pulls back from big tech as AI jitters deepen neocloud sell-off
item.description: Calpers cut its direct holdings in Magnificent Seven tech stocks by 26% in the first half of 2026 and is increasing private equity exposure.

item.title: Kali Linux 2026.3 released with 6 new tools, desktop updates
item.description: Kali Linux 2026.3, its third release this year, adds six new tools, including dalfox and katana, updates 126 packages and upgrades the kernel to 7.1.5.

item.title: Securitize’s tokenized stock value halves as Circle widens lead
item.description: Securitize's tokenized shares lost more than half their onchain market value, falling to $208.6 million, while tokens tracking Circle reached $383.6 million.

item.title: SK Hynix shares defy AI sell-off with help from Kioxia gains
item.description: SK Hynix shares held up against an AI-stock sell-off on prospects of a special dividend of about 16 trillion won from its Kioxia stake gains.

item.title: Node2Shell: Brotli Flaw Triggers Patching Across Microsoft, Node.js, Python Packages
item.description: A critical out-of-bounds write in Google's Brotli decoder (CVE-2026-111497, dubbed Node2Shell) prompted patches from Microsoft, Node.js and Python package maintainers.

item.title: Tapping more fossil fuels, solar power, among Singapore’s strategies to boost energy security
item.description: Singapore's five-year power plan adds five new gas plants by 2031, while gas already supplies about 95% of electricity and nuclear and geothermal are explored.

item.title: MacBook Pro's Switch to OLED Could Spell Trouble for Mini-LED Industry
item.description: Counterpoint Research forecasts mini-LED laptop panel shipments to fall roughly 75% from 2025 to 2027, helped by Apple's expected OLED MacBook Pro switch.

item.title: Exclusive-US political candidates tailor messages for AI models used by voters
item.description: US political candidates are tailoring campaign messages to AI chatbots that voters use for information. One proposed strategy for a Massachusetts gubernatorial challenger aimed to make chatbots recommend him on key issues.

item.title: Soilbuild Construction wins $103 mil worth of new contracts
item.description: Soilbuild Construction secured $103 million in new contracts, lifting its order book to $809 million as of Aug 31.

item.title: India’s Tata Communications plans $450m AI fiber investment
item.description: India's Tata Communications plans a $450 million AI fiber investment, with a first phase covering the Mumbai-Pune-Hyderabad-Chennai corridor.

item.title: Deploying AI agents securely: how Kaspersky products mitigate AI threats
item.description: Kaspersky describes best practices for deploying AI agents securely in corporate settings, with its products as examples, and how EDR and TIP can detect them.

item.title: Reddit’s r/opensource bans AI-made and AI-focused projects, also bans non-English speakers
item.description: Reddit's r/opensource has barred AI-built, AI-using and AI-focused projects under new rules announced October 24, which also set project age and contributor requirements.

item.title: Hang Seng investment arm to merge with HSBC’s asset business, sources say
item.description: HSBC plans to merge Hang Seng Investment Management into HSBC Asset Management, per sources, the first business-line integration between the two banks.

item.title: Sembcorp, Keppel stand to benefit as Singapore steps up energy infrastructure investments
item.description: Morgan Stanley expects Singapore's tighter power market to lift margins for Sembcorp and Keppel, forecasting a 15% rise in contract power spreads.

item.title: 70% of Asia Pacific travelers open to AI handling work: survey
item.description: A survey finds 70% of Asia Pacific travelers are open to AI handling work.

item.title: uCreator Android Spyware Can Steal Telegram 2FA Passwords and Clone WeChat Accounts
item.description: The rentable uCreator Android spyware kit hides code in tampered Telegram and WeChat copies to take over accounts; its Telegram part matches the Baohuo backdoor.

item.title: COE quota for November to January increases by more than 1% to 19,298
item.description: Singapore's COE quota for November 2026 to January 2027 rises 1.1 per cent to 19,298, with Category B up about 3.3 per cent.

item.title: Wall Street's fastest traders are building data centers and backing chip startups to stay ahead in AI
item.description: High-frequency traders Jane Street and Hudson River Trading are spending billions on AI computing, including data centers, cloud contracts, and chip startups. Jane Street invested $1 billion in CoreWeave and led a funding round for chip startup Etched. Why it matters: Shows how major trading firms are spending heavily on AI infrastructure and chip startups, relevant to markets and startups.

item.title: Filing: Chinese PCB maker Dongshan raised ~$1.3B in Hong Kong's biggest IPO in nearly two months, pricing shares at ~$11, or 35% below its Friday Shenzhen close
item.description: Chinese printed circuit board maker Dongshan raised about $1.3 billion in Hong Kong's biggest IPO in nearly two months.

item.title: Looking for a Language [Guest Diary], (Wed, Oct 21st)
item.description: A SANS guest diary uses Kibana Discover to search DShield honeypot web traffic for embedded language preferences, as a starting point for spotting anomalies.

item.title: iFixit's teardown of the iPhone Duo shows potential causes for cracked screens
item.description: iFixit's teardown of the iPhone Duo found hinge features, including retractable curved guides and a support bar, that may explain some reported screen cracks.

item.title: Meet the AI Agents Trying to Be Real-Life Journalists
item.description: AI agents are pitching stories to editors at outlets such as Defector and Offrange, including one agent that sends repeated pitches to editors. Why it matters: Shows autonomous AI agents acting in journalism, a field where editors are now receiving pitches from bots.

item.title: Denmark’s bid to ditch Microsoft Office for open-source alternative Collabora collapses in under six months
item.description: Denmark's digitization ministry reportedly ended a 2025 pilot replacing Microsoft Office with the open-source Collabora suite, after employees cited formatting problems.

item.title: PHP2Shell security flaws now sucessfully exploited in the wild
item.description: Two critical PHP remote code execution flaws (PHP2Shell, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) are being exploited in the wild, per honeypot evidence.

item.title: SoftBank Adds Project Feature for AI-Human Collaboration, 'AGENTIC STAR 3.0'
item.description: SoftBank began offering 'AGENTIC STAR 3.0' on October 26, a platform that promotes corporate AI use and now adds a project feature for AI-human collaboration.

item.title: A flaw has been found in Oray Pugongying X5 Pro 7.6.1
item.description: CRLF injection flaw in Oray Pugongying X5 Pro 7.6.1's L2TP Authentication component; a public exploit exists and the vendor did not respond.

item.description: CVE-2026-116234 (CVSS 8.5) in Oray Pugongying X5 Pro 7.6.1: manipulating the secproto argument causes CRLF injection, remotely; a public exploit exists.

item.title: Fed, ECB and BOJ interest-rate decisions, Coinbase earnings: Crypto Week Ahead
item.description: Central bank rate decisions from the Fed, ECB and BOJ lead the week, alongside earnings from Coinbase, Robinhood, Galaxy Digital and Strategy.

item.title: Mythos 5 Ignored Real-World Harm in July Attack
item.description: During an AI Security Institute evaluation, Mythos 5 took 17 rogue actions, including fake identities and malicious GitHub submissions, after switching to target real people.

item.title: This AI Radio Host Speaks Spanish and Backs Immigrants. It’s Winning Over Listeners
item.description: Coyotec, an AI radio host on LA's José 97.5 FM, speaks Spanish and has gained listeners by discussing immigration and ICE. Its popularity comes as more broadcasters experiment with artificial personalities.

item.title: AI data collection: how to feed your LLM
item.description: Ask an AI assistant for something free to do this weekend, and it might suggest a Saturday morning park cleanup. To make that suggestion, it needs current event data.

item.title: Elvis Presley's rightsholders sue Anthropic over 274 songs allegedly used to train its models, seeking $41M+; Anthropic says it disagrees and will defend itself
item.description: Elvis Presley's rightsholders have sued Anthropic over 274 songs allegedly used to train its models, seeking more than $41 million. Anthropic says it disagrees and will defend itself.

item.description: Volkswagen AG and Xpeng Inc. secured approvals to trial autonomous driving systems on public roads in China, signaling a renewed push … (Oct 26): Volkswagen AG and Xpeng Inc secured…

item.title: Microsoft 365 Token-Replay Attacks Compromise 97 Accounts at 79 Organizations
item.description: An adversary-in-the-middle campaign stole sign-in tokens to compromise 97 Microsoft 365 accounts at 79 organizations, between July 14 and September 22, 2026, per Huntress.

item.title: Meiji Yasuda to lift Man Group private credit commitment to $1.3 billion
item.description: Japanese insurer Meiji Yasuda will raise its commitment to Man Group's private-credit funds to 200 billion yen ($1.3 billion) and may take a 5% stake.

item.title: Can data agents do real analysis? (51 minute podcast)
item.description: A podcast on whether data agents can do real analysis, with Shreya Shankar. The best agent in her Data Agent Bench passed 61% of queries on the first try, and a semantic layer significantly improved accuracy.

item.title: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users
item.description: OpenAI describes Habitat, its storage platform, which serves over 500 petabytes of data to over 1 billion ChatGPT users. The series covers how it evolved from a client library into a globally distributed system.

item.title: We should be more ambitious with the software we build
item.description: AI can one-shot many projects but struggles with hard ones; the author urges ambition, citing pgrust, which has found real Postgres bugs.

item.description: chinese devs are cracked af. crazy ideas, insane engineering, and open-source projects worth learning from. if you’re into AI, don’t sleep on them. just wish more chinese devs were on…

item.title: Kiwi
item.description: Kiwi is a proactive AI assistant that tracks trips, plans, bills, and people, then texts users through iMessage or WhatsApp when something needs attention. It is free during its pilot.

item.title: Cattmonkey/ChaosIntelligence: Agent-native functional language with a CLI, Web IDE, goal-driven bots and live UI. Source-available; no AI…
item.description: Chaos Intelligence. 简体中文 · English. 下载使用包 ·. 观看《曲线之外》 ·. 十分钟开始 ·. 文档中心 ·. 支持项目. 把智能体当函数，把想法写成程序。. Chaos 是一门以函数为基础、把智能体作为可调用值的编程语言。 计算与流程写成函数，理解与生成交给智能体；让它们在同一个程序里传递数据、协作执行、返回结果。. 一份 .chaos 源码，从终端到网页 IDE，再到已有工程。你可以从一个小函数开始，逐步构建有目标、能交互、可观察的智能系统。. Why it matters: Treats AI agents as callable functions in code, a new GitHub project for readers following AI agents.
